## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.2

This release updates the first rune set around the Poison status theme, moves rune artwork into a separate resource pack and improves GUI texture loading performance.

### Highlights

- Reworked the first rune set around the Poison status theme.
- Updated rune names, types and the 26-position rune catalog.
- Added dedicated artwork for all 11 unique rune concepts.
- Moved rune artwork out of the mod JAR into the separate RE:volution Resource Pack.
- Added support for loading the rune textures from the external resource pack.
- Removed runtime PNG decoding from GUI rendering.
- Added client-side rune texture preloading.
- Eliminated the noticeable delay when opening the rune GUI for the first time.
- Added configurable MongoDB URI and database settings through JVM properties.
- Improved rune purchase and awakening handling.
- Updated regression tests for the current Poison rune catalog and rank mechanics.
- Updated project documentation for v1.1.2.

### Current limitations

- The 26-purchase limit is still temporary and will be reworked in later versions.
- Full rune effects are not implemented yet.
- Duplicate rune reward mechanics are not implemented yet.
- Rank visuals and other GUI elements still require further visual polish.
- Some legacy deck/card and Earth-related internal naming remains for compatibility.

### Screenshots

The README and RE:volution Resource Pack repository contain updated screenshots showing the current Poison rune collection and adaptive GUI layouts.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.2.jar`.

The rune artwork is provided separately through the RE:volution Resource Pack:
https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack
